subject: Unfall heute Morgen / accident this morning
body: Hello, this morning at 07:45 another car rear-ended me at the traffic light at Bellevue in Zurich. Nobody is hurt, but my rear bumper and the tailgate are damaged and the car still drives. The other driver (white VW Golf, ZH 482 113) admitted fault, we filled in the European accident report together. My policy number is MOT-7781-2290, car is a Skoda Octavia ZH 77 120. Can I bring it to my own garage? Best regards, Sandra Keller
